analysis.is_complaint_reason: Customer expresses dissatisfaction that three payments he did not make were taken, alleging financial loss of £1,169.91 and a refund is outstanding (CH-1). Refund not credited on time is also dissatisfaction.
analysis.summary: Customer reports three online payments to TechNova Online totalling £1,169.91 (3 x £389.97) on 01/11/2026 between 23:10 and 23:15, which he says he did not make or authorise. He says his card is still in his possession and he has not shared PIN, passcodes or one-time codes. On 02/11 the agent cancelled the card, ordered a replacement and reset online banking password. On 04/11 the refund had not been credited and the customer chased. A statement extract is saved. No card cancellation or refund credit is recorded beyond the cancellation record. Fraud & Scams referral needed for unauthorised transaction review and FRD-1 refund timing check.
